verses.text: Then Job answered:
"Of course, you're the only people who know anything. Wisdom will die when you do.
I have understanding just as you do. I'm not beneath you. Who doesn't know the things you've been saying?
My neighbors laugh at me, even though I used to call on God and he answered me. They laugh at someone who is just and blameless.
People at ease look down on those in trouble. They have contempt ready for anyone whose feet slip.
Robbers live in prosperous tents. Those who provoke God live securely, carrying their god in their own hands.
Ask the animals, and they'll teach you. Ask the birds in the sky, and they'll tell you.
Speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will tell you too.
Which of them doesn't know that the LORD's hand has done this?
The life of every living creature and the breath of all humanity are in his hand.
Doesn't the ear weigh words as the tongue tastes food?
Wisdom comes with age, and understanding with a long life.
God has wisdom and strength. Good counsel and understanding belong to him.
When he tears something down, no one can rebuild it. When he locks someone up, no one can set them free.
When he holds back the waters, they dry up. When he lets them loose, they overturn the land.
Strength and sound wisdom are his. Both the people who deceive and those they deceive belong to him.
He leads advisers away stripped of what they had and makes fools of judges.
He loosens the bonds imposed by kings and ties a belt around their waists.
He leads priests away stripped of what they had and brings down the powerful.
He silences trusted advisers and takes away the judgment of elders.
He pours contempt on nobles and loosens the belts of the strong.
He uncovers what lies hidden in the dark and brings the shadow of death into the light.
He makes nations grow and then destroys them. He expands their territory and then leads their people away captive.
He takes understanding away from the leaders of the earth and makes them wander in a wilderness with no path.
They grope in darkness without light. He makes them stagger like people who are drunk."
